lines.text: Daniel learned Jerusalem's desolation would last seventy years, so he prayed with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
Daniel confessed they had not listened to the priests, and the curse in Moses' Law was poured out.
While Daniel prayed, Michael came in swift flight at the evening sacrifice to give him insight.
Seventy weeks are decreed to put an end to sin, and the one confirming a covenant will end sacrifice.
